issues.description: Both shell if/then/else blocks in the verification workflow omit their closing fi.
issues.rationale: The two GitHub Actions run scripts are syntactically incomplete, so the main and phaseII verification steps cannot reach their intended result handling. The first PR commit adds both fi tokens.
issues.source_evidence: The fixed after workflow has an else branch at lines 38-39 and another at 56-57 with no closing fi. Repair cfcd9e87 adds a fi after each branch.
issues.verification: Fixed workflow and direct repair-diff analysis. Historical workflow execution was not performed.
